meta.name: full-triage-alert
meta.description: Complete Tier 1 triage workflow. Orchestrates the full alert triage process: check-duplicates, triage-alert, enrich-ioc for each entity, and either close (FP/BTP) or escalate (TP/Suspicious). Use for end-to-end alert processing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成告警分类与升级全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要处理大量安全告警并决定是否升级。
copy.tagline_en: Automate full alert triage and escalation workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle many security alerts daily and need to decide escalation.

howto.what: 对给定的告警或案件执行完整的 Tier 1 分诊流程：先检查重复，再分诊并丰富每个实体的 IOC，最后根据分类关闭或升级，并生成报告。
howto.when: 当你提供一个告警 ID 或案件 ID 时触发。

say.text: 对告警 ID ALERT-001 执行完整分诊。
say.note: 工作流会自动检查重复、分诊、丰富IOC并决策。

say.text: 处理案件 CASE-2023-001，进行端到端分诊。
say.note: 会为案件中的每个实体执行IOC丰富。

howto.what_en: Performs a complete Tier 1 alert triage: checks for duplicates, triages the alert, enriches IOCs for each entity, and either closes (FP/BTP) or escalates (TP/Suspicious), then generates a report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an alert ID or case ID.

say_en.text: Run full triage on alert ALERT-001.
say_en.note: Workflow will check duplicates, triage, enrich, and decide.

say_en.text: Perform end-to-end triage for case CASE-2023-001.
say_en.note: Enriches each entity in the case.
